title: PossibleCooker Fennel Pork and Red Lentil Stew
description: Lean pork is seasoned like mild fennel sausage and poached in a thick red lentil and squash gravy.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Choose plain meat-and-bone broth without a vegetable blend.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: Keep warm and use only as needed.

steps.title: Season the pork
steps.text: Gently combine {pork} with {fennel}, {garlic} and {paprika}. Pinch off small, loosely formed pieces about 3/4 inch across.

steps.title: Start the lentils
steps.text: Place {squash}, {lentils} and {broth} in the PossibleCooker. Use Sear/Sauté HIGH with the lid off to bring the liquid to a simmer, about 5–8 minutes.

steps.title: Poach the pork
steps.text: Lower the pork pieces into the simmering broth and return to a simmer on HIGH. Switch to Sear/Sauté LOW and simmer uncovered for 16–22 minutes, stirring gently. The lentils should break down, the squash should mash easily, and several large pork centers must measure at least 160°F.

steps.title: Soften the spinach
steps.text: Fold {spinach} into the hot stew and simmer for 2 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Mix the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Bind the lentil gravy
steps.text: Stir the slurry into the stew at a gentle bubble for 1 minute until the gravy coats the back of a spoon. Add a little {topup} if the lentils have thickened it beyond a spoonable consistency.

steps.title: Serve the stew
steps.text: Turn off the cooker and break up any larger pork pieces with the silicone spoon. Divide the stew and gravy evenly among the bowls.

notes: Make ahead: Mix the fennel-spiced pork and refrigerate covered up to a day ahead. Cut the squash small so it softens at the same rate as the lentils. Option A uses mild fennel and paprika. For gentler Option B, halve the fennel and omit the paprika. Pass extra heat at the table. Refrigerate promptly in shallow portions and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze in individual portions for up to 2 months. Lentils continue to absorb liquid, so loosen the stew as it reheats. Fridge reheat: Warm a single portion with its sauce in a covered HexClad skillet over medium-low, adding a splash of water if thick. Stir or turn gently and begin checking after 5 minutes. Heat the pork to 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw overnight in the refrigerator. Use the fridge reheating directions and stir the sauce smooth. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 369 kcal, 36.8 g protein, 30.5 g total carbohydrate, 11.8 g fat, 5.1 g fiber, 135 mg sodium. Includes the measured broth and sauce. Sodium varies with your broth. Ground pork is estimated at the midpoint of the specified leanness range.
